caption: The drawing is in grayscale and features a central image of a large, detailed tankard or lidded stein with a broad base, a slightly tapered body, an ornate handle, and a decorative thumb lift. The tankard is shaded to suggest a metallic texture. Above the tankard, in the upper section of the drawing, there is a decorative heraldic crest with a shield containing three diamonds and ornate flourishes surrounding it. Flanking the crest, the top left and right corners of the composition contain two technical line-drawings of the tankard: a front view on the left and a right-side profile view on the right. All elements are rendered in pencil or graphite on a light-colored paper background, with distinct outlines and shading to create depth and detail. The artist’s signature, “Dayton Braun,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Tankard
